name: godot-client
author: NeuronScope
description: The Godot client: all of Studio from another computer, with a native 3D view of activations, the emotion jewel and Blender-style navigation. Gets Godot for you, opens the client here, or gives you a download for another machine.

tab.label: Godot client
tab.tip: Studio and its 3D view as a native app (Godot)

jobs.title: Godot client: get Godot
jobs.help: Download Godot 4 for this computer from the Godot project's GitHub releases, check it against the release's SHA-512 list, and keep it in ~/.neuronscope/godot.

jobs.title: Godot client: open
jobs.help: Open the Godot client on this computer, connected to this Studio. It runs until you close it or cancel this job.

fields.name: tab
fields.help: open on a tab, e.g. 3D or Features

fields.name: godot
fields.help: Godot binary (empty: the one from 'get Godot', then godot4/godot on PATH)
